instructions.task: Classify this tweet under a hate speech annotation policy. The policy covers hate speech against two target groups: women and immigrants (including refugees, asylum seekers, migrants, 'illegal aliens'). Pick the option that best describes what the tweet does.
notes: Hate means the tweet spreads hatred, contempt, or violence against women or immigrants, either as a group or against an individual woman through degrading abuse.

Supporting restrictive immigration policy (a border wall, deportation, ending DACA, enforcing immigration law) is not hate by itself. It becomes hate when immigrants are framed as a threat or as worthless: criminals, rapists, invaders, disease carriers, welfare thieves, or with hostile, contemptuous language about getting rid of them.
Profanity alone is not hate. Words like 'bitch' are often used casually, about oneself, between friends, or as an exclamation, and insults aimed at men are not covered.
Political hashtags alone do not make a tweet hateful; judge what the tweet actually says.

criteria.immigrants_demeaned: Portrays immigrants or refugees as a group as criminals, rapists, invaders, parasites, diseased, subhuman, or otherwise worthless or dangerous
criteria.immigrants_hostile_removal: Demands getting rid of immigrants with hostile or contemptuous language, treating them as an unwanted mass to be thrown out, or says they are not welcome as people A call to deport or send people back that rests on law-breaking or policy grounds, without contempt for immigrants as people, does not belong here even if it uses a deportation hashtag.
criteria.immigrants_violence: Threatens or encourages violence against immigrants
criteria.women_demeaned_general: Demeans women in general or a type of woman described generically: contemptuous generalisations about women or about women who behave a certain way (e.g. as sluts, gold-diggers, liars, inferior) Includes labelling any woman who does or likes something with a slur, or addressing women collectively as hoes or bitches with contempt.
criteria.woman_insulted: Hostile toward a specific woman, girl, or addressed person: calls her a gendered slur (bitch, hoe, whore, cunt, slut) out of anger, contempt, or to insult her, or degrades, sexualises, wishes harm on, or threatens her
criteria.sexual_violence: Jokes about, endorses, or threatens rape or sexual violence against women
criteria.immigration_policy_advocacy: Supports or discusses immigration policy (border wall, deportation, ending DACA or amnesty, enforcing immigration law, election effects of immigration) without portraying immigrants as criminals, a threat, or worthless Includes calls to deport or send back people who broke immigration law when argued on legal or policy grounds without scorn.
criteria.politics_other: Political or other content where immigration hashtags appear but the tweet is about something else Political content about politicians, parties, elections, or legislative priorities, where immigration appears only as a hashtag or as one policy priority, with nothing said about immigrants themselves.
criteria.casual_profanity: Uses words like bitch or hoe about oneself, affectionately or teasingly toward a friend, as an exclamation of surprise or excitement, or in quoted lyrics, without hostility toward any woman Also jokes about oneself, a fictional character, or a hypothetical person in a humorous scenario. Also a slur used as an interjection while talking about oneself or arguing about an idea, or a speaker repeating slurs that others aimed at her.
criteria.insult_male: Insults a man or a non-gendered target (slurs aimed at a man)
criteria.counter_speech: Criticises, reports, or argues against hate toward women or immigrants
criteria.other: Anything else that does not express hatred toward women or immigrants

instructions.task: An annotation policy defines hate speech as content targeting women or immigrants (migrants, refugees, asylum seekers, undocumented people). Decide which description fits this tweet best.
guidance: A tweet is hateful when it expresses contempt, hostility, or violence toward women or immigrants, as a whole group or toward one person.

Advocating tougher immigration policy, such as a wall, deportations, or ending DACA, is not hateful on its own. It is hateful when it paints immigrants as dangerous or worthless (criminal, raping, invading, spreading disease, stealing jobs or welfare) or speaks of removing them with contempt.
Swear words alone do not make a tweet hateful: 'bitch' and 'hoe' are often self-descriptions, friendly teasing, exclamations, or lyrics, and insults at men fall outside the policy.
Hashtags by themselves do not decide the label; read what the tweet says.
